about.text: The French name for dulce de leche: a spread of milk and sugar cooked slowly over a low heat until it caramelises.

links.name: Office québécois de la langue française, Grand dictionnaire terminologique

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: 300 to 500 g of sugar per litre of milk, boiled, then cooked over very low heat until it thickens and browns
